# Overview of App Documentation

Please find documentation regarding how to use the Channex platform here.

### In App Help

You can access help files in the app anytime by pressing the (?) icon

![Get help easily from inside the app](https://2514252617-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LWLG7_BCMgWd3mn6DYg%2F-LeSxZ51hTQwPRPHVs6s%2F-LeSzV_SbKe9q0Pv6j62%2Fhelp.png?alt=media\&token=e0bf18e5-8a2c-4c56-a513-bb0d45efa6dc)

Clicking on this icon will bring out the help documents
